label: Build & Run (CMake)
command: cmake -S $ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT -B $ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug > /dev/null && cmake --build $ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/build -j$(nproc) --target $(basename $ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT) && clear && $ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/build/$(basename $ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT) ; echo '' ; echo -n 'Press Enter to close...' ; read

label: Run Python
command: python3 $ZED_FILE ; echo '' ; echo -n 'Press Enter to close...' ; read

label: Run Shell
command: bash $ZED_FILE ; echo '' ; echo -n 'Press Enter to close...' ; read
